rows.en: Next time, let's meet outside of a mission.
Now that's something! You're shaking my soul!
All right, let's head back and rest up!
Heh. I'm counting on you from here on, too.
You really never let my expectations down.
I think we succeeded because I was with you.
Free after this? Hang out with me.
Damn, it's a waste you're a woman. What a guy you are!
rows.notes: Luis calls the female partner a waste as a woman; kept rough and affectionate, in his manner of speaking (you are a real piece of work).

rows.en: With you, we can pull off any mission, right?
The strongest all-woman duo is born right here.
Nothing is impossible for us! Ha ha ha ha!
Why don't we fly a little longer like this?
To think I'd dedicate this mission's success to you.
I felt it, your soul. Your spirit!
We did it! You're more reliable than any man!
Made it back alive. Aside from our luck with men, we're both doing fine.
Aren't we, like, way too strong?
A-after this, would you like to go get a meal?
Whoo! Nice one! I could fall for you!
I'm all sticky now. Let's go back and take a shower.
All right, stay with me till morning. Just us girls, no need to hold back.
We're done! Now let's go stuff ourselves with pineapple cake!
rows.notes: pain-keeki: read as pineapple cake (Yui's favourite in other clips).

rows.en: Macross Broadcasting's opening special, the Miss Macross Contest! 28 beauties picked from 400 entries compete. Who wins the crown? You choose our queen!
rows.notes: Announcer-style clip read by Luis; wording compressed to fit the byte limit.

rows.en: Macross Broadcasting's Miss Macross Contest: Lynn Minmay has been chosen as our leader!
rows.notes: Final word means head/leader; the previous clip says queen, so leader kept literal.

rows.en: Looks like I'll have to sortie too.
Looks like we're ready. Moving out.

rows.notes: Whisper wrote a katakana word (arini); a short pained grunt in a hit-reaction slot, not words.
Whisper heard a long vowel (chii); most likely a tch of annoyance, no words.

rows.en: Schwalbe One to all units, follow me!
rows.notes: Schwalbe flight name (Ivanov's callsign) is not in the glossary.

rows.en: Is there anyone worthy of dancing with me?
Now then, it's time for the fun part.
I thought it would be a bit more fun.
So that's the one I have to take down.
Made me work for it, damn you.
To think my shield got broken.
Don't get cocky over a shield!

rows.notes: Whisper wrote oita wa ikenai; read as oitaa wa ikenai (naughty play is not allowed), teasing the enemy.

rows.en: Bold way to handle a machine.
Yes, that's it! Keep it up!
Don't think you can shoot me down with this much.
Don't think you can take me!
